title: What Was Left Behind
description: A ghoul that moves differently from the others. Not feral, not cognizant — something in between. It pauses in wrong places. It turns toward relay towers like a compass. There is nothing readable in its eyes.
backstory: What remains of Jax Harlan's physical form after Project J-77 extracted his consciousness. The body survived the procedure. Higher cognitive function did not. It has been running on brainstem instinct and forty-seven years of muscle memory — moving toward familiar places, flinching at familiar voices, reaching for a version of itself that is no longer there to receive the signal.

body_wander_01.text: It's moving again. Slow. Northeast, toward the relay tower line. Like it remembers where it's supposed to be, even if it can't remember why.

body_react_voice_01.text:
The ghoul stops.

Something in the Pocket-Boy's static resolves — a voice, partial, broken.

The body turns toward it.

One hand raises, slightly, like the beginning of a gesture. Then lowers again.

body_react_voice_02.text:
The voice from the terminal reaches it.

The ghoul's head tilts. Just slightly. The way someone tilts their head when they hear their name in a crowd and aren't sure they heard it right.

body_react_lena.text:
Lena says his name quietly.

The body does not respond with recognition. But it does not move away, either.

It stays.

body_calm_01.text: It sits against the relay tower pylon like something that belongs there. For a moment it looks almost at rest.

body_sync_warning.text: Neural resonance detected. The body is responding to the signal. Proceed carefully — the outcome is unknown.

body_ending_peace.text:
The body stills. No distress. No final movement toward the tower. Something that was running for forty-seven years simply stops.

The signal goes quiet too.

body_ending_wander.text:
It keeps walking. North, as it always does. The body that was Jax Harlan disappears into the wasteland, moving toward something it will never find.

The mind stays in the towers.

Two halves, permanently divided.

body_ending_sync.text:
The body shudders.

The signal from the relay tower spikes.

And then — something that should not be possible begins to happen.

The eyes focus.
